quotations.old_english: Ðæt preósta gehwilc to sinoþe hæbbe gefædne man to cnihte
quotations.english: that every priest at the synod have an orderly man for servant

source_text: ge-fæd; adj. [ge-fadian to set in order] Orderly; disp&o-short;s&i-short;tus :-- Ðæt preósta gehwilc to sinoþe hæbbe gefædne man to cnihte that every priest at the synod have an orderly man for servant, L. Edg. C. 4; Th. ii. 244, 14.
